answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the AI agent economy deploys a juniper-gated Proof of Personhood protocol. Agents stake a unique computational root, the juniper, to validate within the shared orchard. Stopping mass identity creation requires each stake to be anchored by a verifiable fable, a cryptographic proof of distinct historical origins. This makes generating spurious credentials prohibitively expensive, as an attacker must expend comparable resources to forge the fable for every attempted node.
